sources.snippet: A privacy-first, beginner-friendly desktop application for running large language models fully locally on Windows, Linux, and macOS. Load any GGUF model (Mistral, LLaMA, DeepSeek, Qwen, and thousands more from Hugging Face) and chat with it — with a built-in agentic mode that can read, create, edit, and organize files in a workspace you choose. sources.snippet: KoboldCpp is an easy-to-use AI text-generation software for GGML and GGUF models, inspired by the original KoboldAI. It's a single self-contained distributable that builds off llama.cpp and adds many additional powerful features. Download Releases Here.
